name: tmacleaves
caption:
T-MAC LEFT AT 21 🎮🏀 Tracy McGrady and his cousin Vince Carter, together with us. Then T-Mac left for Orlando.

• 1997: we draft him #9, straight out of high school
• Last season with us (1999-00): 15.4 PPG, 6.3 RPG
• Aug 3, 2000: sign-and-trade to Orlando
• Year 1 in Orlando: 26.8 PPG, All-Star, Most Improved Player
• 2003: scoring champ at 32.1 PPG. Hall of Fame, 2017

If T-Mac stays, do we win a title? 👇

facts.claim: McGrady (born May 24, 1979) was selected ninth overall (#9) by Toronto in the 1997 draft out of high school; teamed with his cousin Vince Carter; signed with Orlando on August 3, 2000 (Aug 3) via sign-and-trade; 2000-01, his first season (year 1) in Orlando: first All-Star and Most Improved Player; 2002-03 (2003) scoring title at 32.1 PPG; Hall of Fame class of 2017; age 21 when he left on Aug 3, 2000 (born May 24, 1979)
